apps.localizedDescription:
YouTube with Shorts permanently removed.

Built from YTLite plus a custom tweak (NoShortsEver) that unconditionally strips:
• The Shorts button in the navigation bar
• Shorts shelves and cells in every feed, search result, and channel
• Any Short that still opens is reopened in the normal video player

Also inherits YTLite's ad-blocking and background playback.

Based on stock YouTube 19.33.2 — an older base chosen because newer YouTube versions (20.x/21.x) enforce a server-side integrity check that cuts off playback on sideloaded apps (the 'Something went wrong' error).
apps.versionDescription: Rebuilt on YouTube 19.33.2 to fix the 'Something went wrong' playback cutoff (newer YouTube enforces a server-side integrity check that breaks sideloaded playback). Same Shorts removal, sign-in fix, and relaunch-scheme fix. Sign-in may work again on this older base.
